description: Wikidata facts for a Swiss municipality by name or BFS number (P771): Q-id, labels, canton, population (latest, with date), area km², elevation m, coordinates, postal codes, official website, coat of arms image, HLS/DHS id and Wikipedia link. Examples: bfs_number=261 (Zürich), name='Lugano', name='Val de Bagnes'. For official BFS statistics prefer get_population / get_municipality; use this for the Q-id join key and enrichment.

language.description: Language for labels and the Wikipedia link (default en)

name.description: Municipality name in any national language, e.g. 'Bern', 'Genève', 'Chur'

name: get_swiss_municipality_facts
title: Swiss municipality facts (Wikidata)
